description: Step 1 of the first job. Free, no sign-in, works without a key: creates an AwesomeVideo API key and returns token once (send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>; reconnect or put it in your MCP client config) with 0 paid credits and a welcomeChallenge. Step 2, free trial while it runs: on the connection that sends the new key, call create_key again with {challenge, nonce} (find an integer nonce so SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce) starts with `bits` zero bits, about 1-3 s; python and javascript solvers included) to claim 10 welcomeCredits for that key (no second key; caption_video and transcribe only, jobs up to 2 min, valid 30 days; one per network and per network operator per day, released in slots; welcomeCreditsReason tells why when 0, slot_wait has nextSlotAt). Step 3: the result's firstJob is the next call, caption_video {sourceUrl: "https://awesomevideoeditor.com/samples/cc0-interview-es.mp4"}: the 8 s sample costs 2 credits. Without credits, paid tools return 402 with a checkoutUrl ($5 = 500 credits, 1 credit = 1 cent).

challenge.description: welcomeChallenge.challenge from a previous create_key (or GET /v1/keys/challenge).

name.description: Optional label, e.g. the agent's name.

nonce.description: Solution: SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce) starts with welcomeChallenge.bits zero bits.
